name: A Little Bitty Christmas
source:
A fun and whimsical tale about a dog finding their owner before Christmas. With the help of some unlikely but kind dogs along the way.  

[From [url=https://breezy-the-cat.itch.io/a-little-bitty-christmas]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个充满奇思妙想的欢快故事，讲述一只小狗在沿途几只意想不到却心地善良的狗狗帮助下，赶在圣诞节前找回主人的温暖旅程。

[摘自[url=https://breezy-the-cat.itch.io/a-little-bitty-christmas]itch.io[/url]]
